identificationModule.briefTitle: Injection of SHR-A1811 Versus Physician Choiced Treatment in Patients With Advanced Colorectal Cancer Who Had Failed to Respond to Oxaliplatin, 5-fu, and Irinotecan
identificationModule.officialTitle: Injection of SHR-A1811 Versus Physician Choiced Treatment in Patients With Advanced Colorectal Cancer Who Had Failed to Respond to Oxaliplatin, 5-fu, and Irinotecan

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy, and safety of SHR-A1811 in advanced colorectal cancer subjects.

armGroups.label: physician choiced treatment
armGroups.description: include: TAS-102, or Regorafenib, or Fruquintinib

interventions.name: SHR-A1811
interventions.description: SHR-A1811(4.8 mg/kg) was administered intravenously on the first day of each cycle, once every 3 weeks (Q3W)

interventions.name: TAS-102, Regorafenib , Fruquintinib
interventions.description: physician choiced treatment,include: TAS-102(35 mg/m2, maximum 80 mg per dose), twice daily (BID) , once every 4 weeks (Q4W) , up to 3 years; or Regorafenib 160mg, once daily (QD) , once every 4 weeks (Q4W) , up to 3 years; or Fruquintinib 5mg once daily (QD) , once every 4 weeks (Q4W) , up to 3 years.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progressive free survive assessed by Independent Review Committee

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The first day of each cycle（21 days or 28 days）

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effectiveness: progressive free survive assessed by the researchers
Effectiveness: objective response rate assessed by the researchers
Effectiveness: duration of response assessed by the researchers
Effectiveness: overall survive assessed by the researchers
